canonical_statement: For every natural number n at least 5 and every smooth compactly supported real-valued function u on R^n whose support avoids the origin, (n(n-4)/4)^2 times the integral of u(x)^2/||x||^4 is at most the integral of (Delta u(x))^2.
domain_and_universes: n : Nat; u : (Fin n -> Real) -> Real; Prop in universe 0; product Lebesgue volume on the finite Pi space
conclusion: (((n : Real) * ((n : Real) - 4)) / 4)^2 * integral x, (u x)^2 / ||x||^4 <= integral x, (laplacian u x)^2

encoding_decisions.euclidean_space: Fin n -> Real with the standard Pi norm and product Lebesgue volume
encoding_decisions.laplacian: standard-coordinate trace of fderiv Real (fun y => fderiv Real u y) x
encoding_decisions.test_class: ContDiff Real top, HasCompactSupport, and zero outside topological support
